newsitem.title: USA: Van der Moolen sees first half profit up.
newsitem.headline: Van der Moolen sees first half profit up.

text.p: Van der Moolen NV said on Tuesday that it expected first half profit per share to "practically double" compared with the same period last year.
In a statement released in New York, the Amsterdam company said results had improved considerably since its March 21 annual shareholders' meeting.
"Accordingly, the executive board is also revising its profit forecast upward from the previous forecast of 10 to 15 percent growth," the company said.

"Taking into account a continuation of the present favorable market circumstances in the Netherlands, the United States, Germany and the United Kingdom, Van der Moolen expects to realize a very significant increase in the present financial year," the statement continued.

Van der Moolen also said it would call an extraordinary shareholders' meeting to approve a proposed five-for-two stock split, reducing the par value from 1.25 guilders to 0.50 guilder per share. The company did not specify a date for the meeting.
